calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as store_count
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-06-01' AND business_date <= '2026-06-28'

SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(net_sales) DESC) as rank,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(r.net_sales) as period_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = r.store_id AND s.is_current = true
WHERE r.business_date >= '2026-06-01' AND r.business_date <= '2026-06-28'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY period_net_sales DESC

SELECT 
    store_id,
    COUNT(*) as days_in_period,
    MIN(business_date) as first_day,
    MAX(business_date) as last_day,
    SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_sales_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative_sales_count
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-06-01' AND business_date <= '2026-06-28'
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY store_id
